summary: Fluence Energy filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Stephan May to its board, effective August 27, 2026, filling a vacancy created by Ruth Gratzke's prior resignation. May, CEO of Electrification and Automation at Siemens Smart Infrastructure, was designated by Siemens Industry under the Stockholders Agreement's director nomination right, exercisable while Siemens-related parties hold 20%+ of Class A shares. This is a routine board fill following a designee change, not a forced or abrupt departure. Appointment is immediate, term expiring at the 2027 annual meeting.
